# hip-rt — safe host runtime

One job: safe RAII host API over `hip-sys`.

## Contents

- [Files](#files)
- [Dependencies](#dependencies)
- [Rules for changes](#rules-for-changes)
- [Human check](#human-check)

## Files

- `device.rs`: `Device` (init, name, arch).
- `module.rs`: `Module::from_elf`, `Function::launch`, `Dim3`.
- `buffer.rs`: `DeviceBuffer<T>` (`from_slice`, `zeroed`, `copy_to_vec`, `tensor`, `tensor_mut`).
- `stream.rs`: `Stream`, `Event` (timing).
- `error.rs`: `HipError`, `Result`.
- `rocblas.rs` (feature `rocblas`): `Handle::sgemm` (row-major).

## Dependencies

- Depends on: `hip-sys`, `hip-tile` (for `Tensor` views on buffers).
- Used by: launchers generated by `#[kernel]`, `apps/runner`, `hip_darknet`.

## Rules for changes

- Read `_shared/rules.md` first.
- Every unsafe FFI call is wrapped; errors become `HipError` with the HIP message.
- Tests live in `apps/runner/tests` (they need the GPU).

## Human check

`cargo test -p runner --release` passes after the change.
